The '''Bakisian Drift''' was a [[Nebula/Legends|nebulosity]]<ref name="GG12">''[[Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies]]''</ref> located in the [[Tragan Cluster/Legends|Tragan Cluster]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The notoriously perilous Bakisian Drift prevented the [[Scout/Legends|exploration]] of the Tragan Cluster up until approximately three [[Standard century/Legends|standard centuries]] before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], when a group of [[Shistavanen/Legends|Shistavanen]] scouts [[Star map/Legends|charted]] the [[Sector/Legends|sector]], discovering several new [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] in the Cluster's [[Star system/Legends|star systems]].<ref name="GG12" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Bakisian Drift was created by [[Craig Robert Carey]] and introduced in ''[[Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies]]'', a [[1995]] sourcebook for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GG12" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed it in in grid square N-5.<ref name="TEA" />
